parameters.query: UPDATE clickup.tasks SET onedrive_link = CASE WHEN $2 = 'onedrive' THEN $1 ELSE onedrive_link END, youtube_link = CASE WHEN $2 = 'youtube' THEN $1 ELSE youtube_link END, synced_at = now() WHERE id = $3;
SELECT value AS admin_chat_id FROM gateway.config WHERE key = 'admin_chat_id' LIMIT 1;

SELECT list_name, status, count(*)::int AS cnt
FROM clickup.tasks
WHERE list_id = $1
GROUP BY list_name, status
ORDER BY cnt DESC;
